findings.conditions: Weight-only int8 DEQUANTIZE feeding FULLY_CONNECTED refuses whole-graph compile on the S26 Adreno (LiteRtException: Failed to compile model). The same graph with fp32 weights or fp16+DEQUANTIZE compiles and runs (4.58 ms). Upstream answer on the same graph form, weight-only int8 through an explicit DEQUANTIZE into FULLY_CONNECTED (LiteRT #9523: `Shape mismatch: {bhwc, {576, 1, 1, 576}} vs {bhwc, {1, 1, 576, 576}}` on Metal, Android OpenCL and macOS WebGPU; 2026-10-01T03:50:36Z, https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT/issues/9523#issuecomment-5924360785): the mismatch "is caused by inconsistent 2D-to-4D `BHWC` auto-expansion conventions across the dequantize and FC paths. Currently, aligning shapes explicitly via `RESHAPE` prior to delegate ingestion is the only workaround". This entry's log has no error text beyond `Failed to compile model`, so the link is by graph form only. Closed as a duplicate of the tracking issue LiteRT #10445 (opened 2026-10-01: standard shape broadcasting, or automatic 4D RESHAPE insertion for lower- and mixed-rank inputs, in the MLDrift GPU delegate).

Upstream answer on the same graph form, weight-only int8 through an explicit DEQUANTIZE into FULLY_CONNECTED (LiteRT #9523: `Shape mismatch: {bhwc, {576, 1, 1, 576}} vs {bhwc, {1, 1, 576, 576}}` on Metal, Android OpenCL and macOS WebGPU; 2026-10-01T03:50:36Z, https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT/issues/9523#issuecomment-5924360785): the mismatch "is caused by inconsistent 2D-to-4D `BHWC` auto-expansion conventions across the dequantize and FC paths. Currently, aligning shapes explicitly via `RESHAPE` prior to delegate ingestion is the only workaround". This entry's log has no error text beyond `Failed to compile model`, so the link is by graph form only. Closed as a duplicate of the tracking issue LiteRT #10445 (opened 2026-10-01: standard shape broadcasting, or automatic 4D RESHAPE insertion for lower- and mixed-rank inputs, in the MLDrift GPU delegate).

findings.conditions: Weight-only int8 DEQUANTIZE feeding FULLY_CONNECTED refuses whole-graph compile on the S26 Adreno (LiteRtException: Failed to compile model). Closed as a duplicate of the tracking issue LiteRT #10445 (opened 2026-10-01: standard shape broadcasting, or automatic 4D RESHAPE insertion for lower- and mixed-rank inputs, in the MLDrift GPU delegate).

findings.conditions: Weight-only int8 DEQUANTIZE feeding FULLY_CONNECTED refuses whole-graph compile on the S26 Adreno (LiteRtException: Failed to compile model). The same graph with fp32 weights or fp16+DEQUANTIZE compiles and runs (4.58 ms). Upstream answer on the same graph form, weight-only int8 through an explicit DEQUANTIZE into FULLY_CONNECTED (LiteRT #9523: `Shape mismatch: {bhwc, {576, 1, 1, 576}} vs {bhwc, {1, 1, 576, 576}}` on Metal, Android OpenCL and macOS WebGPU; 2026-10-01T03:50:36Z, https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT/issues/9523#issuecomment-5924360785): the mismatch "is caused by inconsistent 2D-to-4D `BHWC` auto-expansion conventions across the dequantize and FC paths. Currently, aligning shapes explicitly via `RESHAPE` prior to delegate ingestion is the only workaround". This entry's log has no error text beyond `Failed to compile model`, so the link is by graph form only. Closed as a duplicate of the tracking issue LiteRT #10445 (opened 2026-10-01: standard shape broadcasting, or automatic 4D RESHAPE insertion for lower- and mixed-rank inputs, in the MLDrift GPU delegate).

findings.conditions: Weight-only int8 DEQUANTIZE feeding FULLY_CONNECTED refuses whole-graph compile on the S26 Adreno (LiteRtException: Failed to compile model). The same graph with fp32 weights or fp16+DEQUANTIZE compiles and runs (4.58 ms). Upstream answer on the same graph form, weight-only int8 through an explicit DEQUANTIZE into FULLY_CONNECTED (LiteRT #9523: `Shape mismatch: {bhwc, {576, 1, 1, 576}} vs {bhwc, {1, 1, 576, 576}}` on Metal, Android OpenCL and macOS WebGPU; 2026-10-01T03:50:36Z, https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT/issues/9523#issuecomment-5924360785): the mismatch "is caused by inconsistent 2D-to-4D `BHWC` auto-expansion conventions across the dequantize and FC paths. Currently, aligning shapes explicitly via `RESHAPE` prior to delegate ingestion is the only workaround". This entry's log has no error text beyond `Failed to compile model`, so the link is by graph form only. Closed as a duplicate of the tracking issue LiteRT #10445 (opened 2026-10-01: standard shape broadcasting, or automatic 4D RESHAPE insertion for lower- and mixed-rank inputs, in the MLDrift GPU delegate).
